Overview

## What is the Keenon W3 Delivery Robot?

The Keenon W3 (ButlerBot W3) is an autonomous, enclosed delivery robot for hotels, offices, and multi-story buildings. With up to four independently accessible, lockable compartments and a 20 kg payload, it carries room-service orders, amenities, mail, and packages directly to rooms, floors, or desks — and rides the elevator on its own for contactless, multi-floor delivery.

Automatic compartment doors and continuous ventilation keep deliveries hygienic and fresh, and a long 12-hour battery supports a full day of service. RobotLAB sells, deploys, trains, and services the Keenon W3 nationwide.

How it works

## Keenon W3 Delivery Robot in detail

Built for high-volume buildings, the W3 handles a high daily delivery volume across up to four lockable cabins (up to 90 L total), each opened independently so multiple recipients can be served in one trip. Its enclosed cabin and automatic compartment doors keep items secure and contactless from pickup to drop-off.
